en: A screw is actually an inclined plane wrapped around a central cylinder, which multiplies your turning force.
A pair of scissors cleverly combines two simple machines: a wedge for the blades and a lever for the handles.
Car brake pads use extreme friction to convert a moving vehicle's kinetic energy into heat to stop it.
Gravity is slightly weaker at Earth's equator than at the poles because the planet bulges outward there.
If you cut a bar magnet perfectly in half, you will get two smaller magnets, each with two poles.
Electromagnets in junk yards can lift heavy cars, but dropping the electric current instantly releases the metal.
A single lemon can generate enough electricity through a chemical reaction with metal nails to power a small clock.
Rubbing a balloon on your hair transfers electrons, creating static electricity that makes your hair stand straight up.
Sunlight takes exactly eight minutes and twenty seconds to travel the 150 million kilometers to reach Earth.
Sound travels more than four times faster in water than it does through the air.
Thermos flasks use a complete vacuum layer between their walls to entirely stop heat transfer by conduction.
A roller coaster at the very top of its highest hill possesses its maximum gravitational potential energy.
